messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we need to rebalance the after-launch queue. Bugs blocking customers vs nice-to-have enhancements. Goal: finalize prio by Thurs EOD.
Maria: Agree. I counted 18 open tickets flagged by CS. ~6 are high-sev customer blocks.
Sam: Can we triage by customer impact + engineering cost? I can run a quick pass today.
Kevin: I uploaded a tiny matrix: 
```
impact x effort
H / L -> patch
H / H -> schedule in next sprint
L / L -> backlog
```
Jordan: +1 to Sam. Also flagging the streaming regression (TICKET-452) — needs owner.
Maria: TICKET-452 assigned to @Kevin. Repro steps in the ticket.
Anya: OK: proposal — take all high-impact bugs into next 2-week patch sprint (reserve 40% capacity), push low-effort enhancements into a 'quick-win' mini-release. Anything blocking?
Sam: One constraint — dedicated infra team only available Tue/Wed for the patch rollout.
Kevin: Noted. I'll scope the patch plan to fit that window. 
Maria: CS ok with mini-release timeline, they want a communication plan.
Anya: I'll draft the customer note and put a /remind for send draft tomorrow at 10am.
deploy-bot: Release candidate built: rc-20231014. Logs: https://ci/release/rc-20231014
Jordan: Thanks. After Kevin scopes effort, let's do a 15-min triage at 3pm to lock decisions.
Anya: 3pm works. I'll post the agenda: owners per ticket + rollback plan.
Sam: I'll prep the risk list (latency/compat) and quick test checklist.
Kevin: Adding quant note — batching changes may affect p99. Will include perf tests in checklist.
Maria: :thumbsup:
Anya: Great — aiming to publish the sprint plan by EOD Thu. Thanks team.
